title: Remove marketing routes from web/ and simplify host routing

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Remove app/page.tsx, app/beta, app/contact, app/features, app/waitlist and
their components/lib modules from web/ once task 8 has landed them in
Chattic.us-web and story 1 is verified. Remove WEB_MARKETING_DOMAINS from
infra/lib/environments.ts, the marketing alias records and MarketingSiteUrl
output from infra/lib/web-stack.ts. Simplify the SpaViewerRequest CloudFront
function in infra/lib/cloudfront-functions.ts: with no marketing pages in the
bucket, / serves the workspace unconditionally and the host-based
Host===siteDomain branch is dead code to delete, leaving only the generic
extensionless-path SPA rewrite.

Depends on task 8 landing and story 1 passing verification first.
